__broaden__.τῷ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); masc./neut. dat. sg., ’to him’ · also adverbial, ’therefore’ · also neut., ’on it’ (τῷ … ἐρεισάμενος ’leaning on it’) · also with a noun, ’that, the’ (ἤματι τῷ ’on that day’; τῷ δεκάτῳ ’in the tenth’) · also instrumental, ’with it’ (τῷ … τύψε ’struck with it’) · also relative, instrumental: ’with which’ · also causal/instrumental, ’by it’ (τῷ τείρετο ’was worn by it’) · also with ἅμα, of company: ’with him’ (τῷ … ἅμ’ ’along with him’)
__broaden__.ὑπὸ: ὑπό — under, beneath; adv. and preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ὑπὸ … τάνυσσαν ’stretched under’) · also prep. + acc. of motion: ’to, under’ (ὑπὸ Ἴλιον ἦλθον ’came to Ilios’) · also prep. + dat., ’under, beneath’ (ὑπὸ πλατανίστῳ ’beneath a plane-tree’) · also prep. + dat. with τίκτω, of the father: ’to’ (ὑπὸ Πειριθόῳ τέκετο ’bore to Peirithous’) · also prep. + gen.: ’beneath, from under’ (ὑπὸ στέρνοιο ’beneath the breast’) · also prep. + gen. of cause: ’under (the blast of)’ (ὑπὸ Ζεφύροιο ἰωῆς) · also prep. + dat. of cause, placed after its noun: ’under the weight of’ (καμάτῳ … ὑπό ’from toil’)
__broaden__.γυῖα: γυῖον — limb; neut. acc. pl., object of ἔλλαβε · also neut. acc. pl., object of λῦσε: ’loosed the limbs’ (λῦσε δὲ γυῖα) · also neut. acc. pl., goal of motion with δέδυκεν: ’has sunk into the limbs’ · also neut. nom. pl., subject of a passive: ’the limbs were loosened’ (λύντο δὲ γυῖα)
__broaden__.ἀντίος: ἀντίος — opposite, facing, to meet (+ gen.); masc. nom. sg. · also + dat., ’to meet, against’ (τῇ δ’ ἀντίος ’to meet her’)
__broaden__.μάχης: μάχη — battle, fight; fem. gen. sg., after ἀπάνευθε · also fem. gen. sg., governed by εἰδότε: ’skilled in all (fighting)’ · also fem. gen. sg. of separation, with ἔσχοντο: ’from the fighting’ · also fem. gen. sg., object of ἀντιβολῆσαι: ’to meet (the battle)’ · also fem. gen. sg. of place, with ἐπ’ ἀριστερά: ’on the left of the battle’ · also fem. gen. sg., governed by ἀδαήμονι: ’ignorant of (battle)’ · also fem. gen. sg. of separation, with ἐξαποδίωμαι: ’out of the battle’ · also fem. gen. sg., dependent on ἔργον: ’of battle’ (ἔργον … μάχης ’work of battle’) · also fem. gen. sg., dependent on νίκην: ’victory of battle’ (μάχης νίκην)
__broaden__.πίθοιο: πείθομαι — obey, heed (+ dat.); aor. opt. 2 sg. mid., in a polite request: ’you might obey’ · also in a condition after εἰ: ’if you would obey’ (εἴ μοί τι πίθοιο)
__broaden__.τέκμωρ: τέκμωρ — a fixed mark, sign, pledge; neut. nom. sg. (indecl.) · also goal, end, issue (τέκμωρ Ἰλίου ’the end of Ilios’)
__broaden__.τοί: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. nom. pl. τοί (= Attic οἱ), used as a relative: ’who’ · also τοί = τοι, encl. dat. of σύ: ’to you’ (κασίγνητος δέ τοί εἰμι ’I am your brother’)
__broaden__.μοῖρα: μοῖρα — fate, portion, lot; fem. nom. sg. · also with an inf., ’it is fated’ (μοῖρα θανεῖν ’fated to die’)
__broaden__.ἐχεύατο: χέω — pour, shed; aor. 3 sg. mid., epic; with ἀμφί in tmesis: ’threw (her arms) about’ · also intransitive, of a ripple: ’spread, was shed over’ (φρὶξ ἐχεύατο ’the ripple spread’)
__broaden__.ἔπι: ἐπί — on, upon, over; prep. + dat., placed after its relative with anastrophe (ᾧ ἔπι = ἐφ’ ᾧ ’for which’) · also ἔπι = ἔπεστι, ’is there’, verb with anastrophe (οὐ … ἔπι δέος ’there is no fear’) · also ἔπι = ἐπί placed after its noun, with anastrophe: ’at’ (πηγῇς ἔπι ’at the springs’) · also ἔπι = ἐπί + acc. placed after its noun, ’to’ (νῆας ἔπι γλαφυράς ’to the hollow ships’) · also ἔπι = ἐπί + dat. placed after its noun: ’to’ (νηυσὶν ἔπι γλαφυρῇσιν ’to the hollow ships’) · also ἔπι = ἐπί + acc. placed after its noun, ’over’ (πόντον ἔπι ’over the sea’)
__broaden__.αὐτῆς: αὐτός — self; fem. gen. sg., intensive with a name: ’Hecuba herself’ · also fem. gen. sg., intensive with a possessive: ’of yourself’ (τὰ σ’ αὐτῆς ἔργα ’your own tasks’) · also fem. gen. sg., plain pronoun: ’it’ (ὑπ’ αὐτῆς ’under it’)
__broaden__.δόμεναι: δίδωμι — give; aor. inf., epic -μεναι (= Attic δοῦναι) · also inf. as imperative: ’let (them) give back’ (σῶμα … δόμεναι)
__broaden__.δώῃ: δίδωμι — give, grant; aor. subj. 3 sg. (= Attic δῷ), after αἴ κε: ’may grant’ · also aor. subj. 3 sg. in a clause joined to εἰ κ’ + subj.: ’grants’ (δώῃ δέ μοι εὖχος ’and grants me glory’)
__broaden__.σῆμα: σῆμα — sign, mark; neut. nom. sg., subject: ’sign’ · also neut. acc. sg., predicate, with κικλήσκουσιν understood: ’tomb’ (σῆμα Μυρίνης ’the tomb of Myrine’) · also neut. acc. sg., object: ’a token’ (σῆμα ἰδέσθαι ’to see the token’) · also neut. nom. sg., predicate: ’tomb’ (ἀνδρὸς τόδε σῆμα ’the tomb of a man’)
__broaden__.εἵατ: ἧμαι — sit; pres. 3 pl., epic εἵαται (= Attic κάθηνται), elided (εἵατ’ = εἵαται): ’sit’ · also impf. 3 pl., elided (εἵατ’ = εἵατο, = Attic ἧντο): ’sat’
__broaden__.ἀμφοτέροισιν: ἀμφότερος — both (of two); masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις), after μετά: ’among both’ · also dat. of interest: ’for both’
